title: 第82章 方寸洞天第81章 符业之祖
content_zh:
第82章方寸洞天
本命符炁点化，眉心识海中，那枚核桃大小的山珠子骤然展开，一片灰蒙蒙的混沌空间徐徐铺开，其间土气氤氲，似有流光暗转。
吴燃灯神念探入，瞬间明了此物来历。
竟是一方息壤福土！
息壤，大地土之精华，乃先天土炁凝结而成。
万物由气而生，气返先天便为炁，这息壤正是土炁的极致形态，遇风即长，生生不息，堪称无价之宝。
更惊人的是，此物可补天！
大修士开辟清灵洞天，虽能藏于世外，却终有寿限。
待洞天崩塌，地脉断绝，纵是神通广大，也难修补，唯有这大千世界孕育的息壤，能续接地脉，重定洞天根基。
“竟是此物……”吴燃灯手掌握紧，只觉掌心的山珠子烫得惊人。
这等至宝，足以让元神老怪为之疯狂，如今竟成了自己的本命法宝。
混沌空间中，息壤如一团活物般蠕动，散发着厚重的土炁，与他的本命符炁丝丝相缠。
吴燃灯很快察觉，手中山珠子藏的秘密，比息壤更惊人，竟是更高一品的息壤福土。
息壤沉淀到极致，便会孕育出造化之力，内藏一片灵土小时空。
修士得之，可自行布置时空格局，随心塑造其中景象。
要知道，元神大修士证道时，凭空开辟洞天需耗损海量本源，代价极大。
可若有这息壤福土，便能省去从无到有创世的过程，直接以灵土为基，衍化洞天。
这等奇物，纵是元神修士也视若珍宝，求而不得！
吴燃灯按下心头惊悸。
如此稀世之珍，绝不能泄露分毫。

以他如今炼气修为，身怀此宝，无异于稚子抱金过市，凶险至极。
他深吸一口气，强行压下翻涌的心绪，神念微动。
下一刻，原地身影消散，吴燃灯已立身于一片灰蒙蒙的土地上。
脚下是温润的息壤，四周混沌未开，唯有土炁流转，带着一股初生般的厚重生机。
这里，便是息壤福土内蕴的小时空。
吴燃灯低头打量着脚下灵土，指尖轻触，息壤便如活物般微微起伏。
他能清晰感觉到其中蕴藏的造化之力，仿佛轻轻一引，便能生出草木山川。
“好东西……”他低声感叹，眼中却无半分松懈。
这等至宝，既是机缘，也是祸根。
唯有尽快提升修为，方能护得住这份造化。
吴燃灯立于这片灰蒙蒙的天地间，抬眼不见日月，低眉不着四野，唯有脚下方寸福土坚实可依，俨然一副天地未开的混沌景象。
“原来如此……”他心中豁然开朗。
这独立空间，正是山珠子诸多玄妙的根源。
所谓遮掩气息，是因空间自成隔绝，外界神念难探，灵气波动亦被锁于其内。
所谓转煞为灵，盖因息壤本是先天土炁所凝，能如海绵般吸纳周遭煞气，转化为精纯灵气，反哺自身。
而先前“身处无间”的诡异感，皆是因他未得此物认主，既非空间内的存在，也非空间外的过客，恰好处在空间夹层，故有那般不上不下的困顿。
吴燃灯俯身，指尖触及脚下息壤，只觉温润厚重，隐隐有吸力传来，似要将周遭一切气息都纳入其中。
他试着引动一丝外界煞气，那煞气刚靠近，便被息壤无声无息吞噬，转瞬间，一缕稀薄却精纯的灵气从土中渗出，萦绕在他指尖。
“果然奇妙。”吴燃灯颔首。
有此空间隔绝气息，日后身怀至宝亦能隐匿行藏。

有此息壤转化灵气，修行再无需愁灵脉贫瘠。

Chapter 82 A small cave
The natal talisman Qi was attuned, and in the sea of awareness between the eyebrows, the walnut-sized mountain bead suddenly unfolded, and a gray and chaotic space slowly spread out, filled with earthy atmosphere, and there seemed to be a flowing light.
Wu Randeng's spiritual thoughts penetrated and he instantly understood the origin of this object.
It is actually a blessed land!
Xi soil, the essence of the earth, is the condensation of innate soil Qi.
All things are born from Qi, and when Qi returns to the innate world, it becomes Qi. This breath soil is the ultimate form of soil Qi. It grows when it encounters the wind and is endless. It is a priceless treasure.
What’s even more amazing is that this thing can mend the sky!
The great monk opened the Qingling Cave. Although he can hide in the world, his lifespan is limited.
When the cave sky collapses and the earth's veins are severed, it will be difficult to repair it even with great magical powers. Only the soil bred by this vast world can continue to connect the earth veins and reestablish the foundation of the cave sky.
"It's actually this thing..." Wu Randeng tightened his grip and felt that the mountain beads in his palm were surprisingly hot.
This kind of treasure is enough to drive the old monster of Yuanshen crazy, and now it has become his own magic weapon.
In the chaotic space, the living soil squirmed like a ball of living things, exuding thick earth Qi, intertwined with the Qi of his natal talisman.
Wu Randeng soon realized that the secret hidden in the mountain bead in his hand was even more amazing than the Xi soil. It was actually a higher grade Xi soil blessed soil.
When the soil settles to the extreme, it will breed the power of creation and contain a small space of spiritual soil.
Once a monk obtains it, he can arrange the pattern of time and space and shape the scene as he pleases.
You must know that when the Yuanshen Great Monk attains enlightenment, it takes a huge amount of energy to open a cave out of thin air, which is extremely costly.
But if there is this blessed land of breath soil, we can save the process of creating the world from scratch and directly use the spiritual soil as the basis to develop the cave heaven.
Even the Yuanshen monks regard such rare objects as treasures, and they cannot get them if they ask for them!
Wu Randeng suppressed his panic.
Such a rare treasure must not be leaked.
With his current level of Qi refining and cultivation, carrying this treasure is no different than a child holding gold in the market, which is extremely dangerous.
He took a deep breath, forced to suppress the surging emotions, and moved his mind slightly.
The next moment, the figure disappeared, and Wu Randeng was already standing on a gray land.
There is warm soil under the feet, and the surroundings are chaotic. Only the earth is flowing, with a thick vitality like a newborn.
Here is the small space that contains the blessed soil.
Wu Randeng lowered his head and looked at the spiritual soil under his feet. When he touched it lightly with his fingertips, the soil undulated slightly like a living thing.
He could clearly feel the power of creation contained in it, as if he could give birth to grass, trees, mountains and rivers with just a slight pull.
"Good stuff..." He sighed in a low voice, but his eyes were not relaxed at all.
This kind of treasure is both an opportunity and a curse.
Only by improving your cultivation as soon as possible can you protect this good fortune.
Wu Randeng stood in this gray sky and earth. He couldn't see the sun and moon when he raised his eyes. He lowered his eyebrows and couldn't see the surrounding fields. There was only a solid inch of blessed soil under his feet. It was like a chaotic scene where the heaven and earth had not yet opened up.
"So that's it..." He suddenly felt enlightened.
This independent space is the source of many mysteries of Shanzhuzi.
The so-called concealing the aura is because the space is isolated by itself, making it difficult for outside spiritual thoughts to detect, and the fluctuations of spiritual energy are also locked within it.
The so-called turning evil spirits into spirits is because the living soil is originally condensed with innate earth Qi. It can absorb the surrounding evil spirits like a sponge, transform it into pure spiritual energy, and feed it back to itself.
The strange feeling of "being in the middle" before was all because he had not recognized the owner of this object. It neither existed in the space nor was it a passerby outside the space. He happened to be in the middle of the space, so he felt stuck in the middle of the space.
Wu Randeng leaned forward and touched the soil under his feet with his fingertips. He felt warm and thick, and there was a faint suction coming from him, as if he wanted to absorb all the breath around him.
He tried to induce a trace of external evil energy. As soon as the evil energy came close, it was swallowed up by the soil silently. In an instant, a thin but pure spiritual energy seeped out from the soil and lingered on his fingertips.
"It's really amazing." Wu Randeng nodded.
With this space to isolate the breath, you can hide your precious treasures in the future..
With this breath soil transforming spiritual energy, there is no need to worry about poor spiritual veins in practice.
